preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_code WHERE code_name = 'Customer Identifier'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_code_value (id, code_id, code_value, code_description, order_position, code_score, is_active, is_mandatory) SELECT nextval('m_code_value_id_seq'), code.id, requested.code_value, 'Required by Arissto client KYC migration', requested.order_position, NULL, TRUE, FALSE FROM m_code code CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('NIT', 5), ('Carné de residencia', 6)) requested(code_value, order_position) WHERE code.code_name = 'Customer Identifier' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_code_value existing WHERE existing.code_id = code.id AND existing.code_value = requested.code_value );

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM m_code_value value USING m_code code WHERE value.code_id = code.id AND code.code_name = 'Customer Identifier' AND value.code_value IN ('NIT', 'Carné de residencia') AND value.code_description = 'Required by Arissto client KYC migration' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_client_identifier identifier WHERE identifier.document_type_id = value.id );
